visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a colorful cartoon scene featuring two characters, an anthropomorphic sponge and a pink starfish, sitting at a wooden picnic table underwater. The sponge character holds a small purple seashell while various food items like burgers and pie are on the table against a background of green kelp. (2) The scene cuts to a real-world underwater environment where a cone-shaped snail with a brown and white patterned shell is partially submerged in white sand. The lighting is natural and bright, showing the texture of the seabed. (3) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, appears in a studio setting. He is positioned in front of a blurred bookshelf and a warm lamp, gesturing with his hands as he looks directly at the camera. (4) Close-up shots follow, focusing on the cone snail's anatomy, specifically a thin, reddish-brown mouth tube extending outward. A diagram then appears on a white background showing a microscopic, needle-like tooth labeled with a scale bar of 1000 micrometers. (5) Underwater footage captures the cone snail's predatory behavior, showing its proboscis making contact with a small, colorful striped fish. The background is a mix of coral and sandy substrate under clear blue water. (6) The video transitions through several quick cuts showing medical-themed imagery: an older man in a purple shirt clutching his chest, an elderly woman in a hospital bed with an oxygen tube, and a black man holding his neck in pain. These shots have a cinematic, high-contrast lighting style. (7) A scuba diver in full gear, including yellow fins and a black wetsuit, is shown swimming over a vibrant coral reef. Later, a digital interface for 'AI Ocean' is displayed, featuring a grid of marine life photographs and technical data. (8) The final phases show the man in the black shirt concluding his speech in the studio, while the BlueTrend logo and various promotional text overlays appear on screen, including a whiteboard with handwritten notes about data empowerment.
